visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black pigtails, glasses, and a dark red/black maid-style outfit stands outdoors, holding multiple shopping bags and a large pink pillow. She speaks with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. (2) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a blue checkered shirt and a black backpack, enters the frame. He gestures toward his gear, including a professional camera with a large white lens. (3) The scene shifts to an urban sidewalk during bright daylight. The two characters interact, showing off their anime-themed items and a digital camera. (4) The visuals transition into a mock 'Special Alert' news format with emergency graphic overlays and flashing light effects. The characters are seen running in slow motion with panicked expressions. (5) The characters are shown lying on the stone-paved ground, looking up in awe or fear, and then quickly posing for a selfie. (6) An interview setup appears with a pink microphone bearing a logo. The characters take turns speaking directly to the off-screen interviewer. (7) Multiple cans of Taiwan Beer with different Godzilla illustrations are displayed in close-up shots against various outdoor backgrounds (cityscape, windmill, airport, bridge). (8) The two characters hold the beer cans toward the camera in a group shot. (9) The final scene shows the man standing alone, looking thoughtful as he talks to himself.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo electronic pop BGM begins. A high-pitched, excited female voice speaks rapidly in Traditional Chinese. (2) A sharp transition SFX leads into a slightly lower-pitched male voice speaking conversationally. (3) A sudden siren SFX and dramatic deep-voiced narration (resembling a news alert) cuts in over the upbeat music. (4) Percussive impact SFX and whooshes occur as the scene changes to the running sequence. (5) Soft, whimsical piano notes play briefly when the characters share a glance. (6) The BGM swells in volume and intensity during the product showcase, featuring a strong rhythmic beat. (7) The male voice returns with a more thoughtful, internal monologue tone at the very end as the BGM fades out.
